seo.title: Stillroom — calm music for sleep, focus and relaxation
seo.description: Generative calm music, binaural beats, Solfeggio frequencies and nature sounds with living backgrounds. Free to listen in the browser and on Android.

home.hero_subtitle: Music for sleep, relaxation, meditation and focus — with a living background for every sound.

tracks.title: Stress relief
tracks.subtitle: 432 Hz · 6 breaths/min
tracks.details: 432 Hz tuning · one swell every 10 s
tracks.description: Warm pads that rise and fall at six breaths a minute. Let your breathing follow the swell.

tracks.title: Deep relaxation
tracks.subtitle: Lydian pads · surf
tracks.details: 432 Hz tuning · bells and distant surf
tracks.description: Open, floating chords with slow bells and far-off waves. For unwinding after a long day.

tracks.title: Deep sleep
tracks.subtitle: Low drones · brown noise
tracks.details: 432 Hz tuning · 16 s chords · brown noise
tracks.description: Dark drones that barely move, over a bed of brown noise. Set the timer and let it fade.

tracks.title: Anxiety calm
tracks.subtitle: Steady · soft rain
tracks.description: Predictable, slow harmony with nothing sudden in it. Soft rain fills the gaps.

tracks.title: Meditation
tracks.subtitle: Drone · singing bowls
tracks.details: D drone · a bowl every 15–30 s
tracks.description: One steady drone and a singing bowl struck now and then. Count your breaths between strikes.

tracks.title: Focus
tracks.subtitle: Slow arpeggio · pink noise
tracks.description: Even, wordless motion that holds attention without pulling it. For reading and deep work.

tracks.title: Lo-fi chill
tracks.subtitle: 72 BPM · tape crackle
tracks.description: Jazzy chords, a soft muted beat and vinyl crackle. Easy background for anything.

tracks.title: Calm piano
tracks.subtitle: Felt piano · space
tracks.description: Single notes and soft chords with plenty of room between them.

tracks.title: Spa & yoga
tracks.subtitle: Water · chimes
tracks.description: Running water, chimes and a warm open pad. Made for stretching and slow flows.

tracks.title: Gentle morning
tracks.subtitle: Bright pads · birds
tracks.description: Light, rising chords and a few birds outside. A soft start to the day.

tracks.title: Creative flow
tracks.subtitle: Dorian · ripples
tracks.description: Curious, unresolved harmony that moves just enough to keep ideas coming.

tracks.title: Delta sleep
tracks.subtitle: 2 Hz · Delta
tracks.details: Binaural · 2 Hz beat · 120 Hz carrier · headphones
tracks.description: The slowest brainwave band, linked with deep, dreamless sleep. Left ear 120 Hz, right ear 122 Hz.

tracks.title: Theta meditation
tracks.subtitle: 6 Hz · Theta
tracks.details: Binaural · 6 Hz beat · 180 Hz carrier · headphones
tracks.description: Linked with meditation, drowsiness and dream-like imagery. Left ear 180 Hz, right ear 186 Hz.

tracks.title: Alpha calm
tracks.subtitle: 10 Hz · Alpha
tracks.details: Binaural · 10 Hz beat · 200 Hz carrier · headphones
tracks.description: Linked with calm, relaxed wakefulness. Works best with eyes closed. Left 200 Hz, right 210 Hz.

tracks.title: Beta focus
tracks.subtitle: 16 Hz · Beta
tracks.details: Binaural · 16 Hz beat · 220 Hz carrier · headphones
tracks.description: Linked with alert, active concentration. Left ear 220 Hz, right ear 236 Hz.

tracks.title: Gamma clarity
tracks.subtitle: 40 Hz · Gamma
tracks.details: Binaural · 40 Hz beat · 250 Hz carrier · headphones
tracks.description: The fastest band, studied for attention and memory. Left ear 250 Hz, right ear 290 Hz.

tracks.title: 174 Hz
tracks.subtitle: Grounding
tracks.description: The lowest Solfeggio tone. Deep and steady, felt as much as heard.

tracks.title: 285 Hz
tracks.subtitle: Restoration
tracks.description: Traditionally linked with rest and recovery.

tracks.title: 396 Hz
tracks.subtitle: Release
tracks.description: Traditionally linked with letting go of fear and guilt.

tracks.title: 417 Hz
tracks.subtitle: Change
tracks.description: Traditionally linked with clearing old patterns and starting over.

tracks.title: 432 Hz
tracks.subtitle: Natural tuning
tracks.description: A pure 432 Hz tone over a pad tuned to A = 432 instead of the standard 440.

tracks.title: 528 Hz
tracks.subtitle: Love frequency
tracks.description: The most popular Solfeggio tone, often called the love or miracle tone.

tracks.title: 639 Hz
tracks.subtitle: Connection
tracks.description: Traditionally linked with relationships and harmony.

tracks.title: 741 Hz
tracks.subtitle: Clarity
tracks.description: Traditionally linked with expression and a clear mind.

tracks.title: 852 Hz
tracks.subtitle: Intuition
tracks.description: Traditionally linked with inner calm and awareness.

tracks.title: 963 Hz
tracks.subtitle: Awareness
tracks.description: The highest Solfeggio tone, traditionally linked with a sense of oneness.

tracks.title: Rain
tracks.subtitle: Window rain
tracks.description: Steady rain on a window. Masks voices and street noise.

tracks.title: Ocean waves
tracks.subtitle: One wave / 14 s
tracks.details: Surf · about one wave every 14 seconds
tracks.description: Slow surf rolling in and drawing back. Easy to breathe along with.

tracks.title: Forest night
tracks.subtitle: Crickets · breeze
tracks.description: Crickets, a light breeze through the trees and nothing else.

tracks.title: Mountain stream
tracks.subtitle: Running water
tracks.description: A shallow stream over stones. Bright, constant and soothing.

tracks.title: Brown noise
tracks.subtitle: Deep rumble
tracks.details: Noise · energy falls 6 dB per octave
tracks.description: A deep, soft rumble with most of its energy in the bass. Popular for sleep and blocking low traffic hum.

tracks.title: Pink noise
tracks.subtitle: Balanced
tracks.description: Balanced like steady rain. Each octave carries the same energy.

tracks.title: White noise
tracks.subtitle: Flat hiss
tracks.description: An even hiss across every frequency. The strongest masker for loud rooms.
